title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 11: Solve a practical problem politely

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Notice the difference between a short instruction and a polite request. In your notes, write the problem, the request and the confirmation question; then say all three with the notes covered.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Cochez la case obligatoire, s'il vous plaît.
steps.tip: Say it: koh-SHAY lah kahz oh-blee-gah-TWAHR, seel voo pleh

steps.fr: N'appuyez pas sur le bouton avant de vérifier le numéro.
steps.en: Do not press the button before checking the number.
steps.tip: Say it: nah-pü-yay pah sür luh boo-TOH(N) ah-vah(n) duh vay-ree-FYAY luh nü-may-ROH

steps.fr: Pourriez-vous vérifier le numéro de suivi ?
steps.en: Could you check the tracking number?
steps.tip: Say it: poo-ree-YAY voo vay-ree-FYAY luh nü-may-ROH duh sü-vee

steps.fr: Je voudrais une réponse écrite, s'il vous plaît.
steps.en: I would like a written reply, please.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh voo-DREH ün ray-POHNS ay-KREET, seel voo pleh

steps.en: Could you tell me the first step?
steps.tip: Say it: poo-ree-YAY voo ma(n)-dee-KAY lah pruh-MYEHR ay-TAHP

steps.fr: Ne signez pas le formulaire incomplet.
steps.en: Do not sign the incomplete form.
steps.tip: Say it: nuh see-NYAY pah luh for-mü-LEHR a(n)-kohn-PLEH

steps.en: Would you like a file follow-up?
steps.tip: Say it: voo-dree-YAY voo uh(n) sü-vee duh doh-SYAY

steps.fr: Merci. Je confirme le délai de traitement.
steps.en: Thank you. I am confirming the processing time.
steps.tip: Say it: mehr-SEE; zhuh kohn-FEERM luh day-LEH duh treht-MAH(N)
